name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.7.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL/HermiT and Cube against gold SQL. Adds opt-in structured counterexample reduction with dependency-group deletion and non-key value simplification, and typed finite-domain synthetic inputs generated with optional pinned Z3. PostgreSQL still compares both queries; bounded UNSAT, timeout or no disagreement is not an equivalence proof. Version 2 fixtures bind inputs and validate the transformation trace; default row-only reduction and legacy replay remain supported. Existing version 1 configurations need no new setting. Rerun build, reason, cube and verify after upgrading; no shared MVCC snapshot across Cube or stages or runtime attestation is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
